from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class StockReportRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single record extracted from one financial report regarding stock identification."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name identified in the document header")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="The security/stock code listed in the document header")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period covered by this document (e.g. '2021 Q1')")
    disclosure_date: str | None = Field(description="The date the report was officially disclosed/published")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    stock_reports: list[StockReportRecord]
